curator_notes: Modifier leg: glucose deprivation engaged the NRF2-ferroptosis axis in T47D (GSE153830; Zhang et al. 2021). Drug leg: metformin induces ferroptosis in breast cancer cells via SLC7A11 UFMylation inhibition (Yang et al. 2021). No combination viability readout exists in either study — inferred via shared ferroptosis mechanism.

related.curator_notes: [Mechanistic Bridging -- model-generated hypothesis, not a tested result] Glucose restriction (5% of standard medium glucose) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (death_promoting) in T47D; Erastin's reported resistance mechanism runs through the same pathway (GPX4-dependent lipid-peroxide detoxification). Because the modifier's effect on this pathway is death-promoting (suppresses the pathway the drug's resistance depends on), this is surfaced as a synergy candidate. This combination has not been evaluated together in any cited study -- it is a candidate for testing, generated by matching independently-curated signature and resistance-mechanism evidence, not a direct or inferred empirical finding.

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: GPX4 detoxifies lipid peroxides downstream of cystine/glutathione depletion; sufficient GPX4 activity (or an intact glutathione pool feeding it) can rescue cells from erastin's system Xc- blockade despite cystine starvation (Dixon et al. 2012; Yang et al. 2014).
